svg.title: Forester — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as forester, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A stepped conifer silhouette stands beside a clearly graduated tree-measuring staff. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
